head: 30ca31a0
gate: CDS DNS clusters distinguish LOGICAL_DNS from STRICT_DNS re-resolution
change: `dnsChildPolicy` now sets `ignoreReresolutionRequests` from the cluster's discovery kind instead of always true. LOGICAL_DNS keeps `true` (resolve once when the CDS resource is applied); STRICT_DNS sets `false` so a connection failure can request an address-list refresh, matching gRFC A27. Added `Cluster.isLogicalDns()`.

evidence.runtime_test: src/grpc/xds/runtime/target_tests.zig 'gRPC xDS target resolves a LOGICAL_DNS cluster without re-resolution'
logical_assertions: one endpoint with host logical.test and port 1003
evidence.resolution_consumer: src/grpc/channel.zig only requests re-resolution for a slot when `!ignoresReresolution(slot)`, so the flag reaches the resolver refresh path.

notes: Both discovery kinds already shared one runtime path; only the re-resolution flag differed. Aggregate clusters were already expanded into ordered priorities and covered by an existing target test.
